weather.note: 今天（8/24 週一）台北是「悶熱＋午後強降雨」的組合：西南風與低壓帶持續影響，北部高溫落在 30–33°C，沒下雨時仍然很熱、體感更高。中央氣象署提醒 8/24 之前全台仍要防豪雨，午後熱力作用下對流發展旺盛，台北市區與近山區傍晚前後可能出現大雨或短延時豪雨。　通勤重點：早上出門就把傘帶著，下午 14:00–19:00 是雨勢最集中的時段，機車族請預留多一點時間。　🌀 颱風「沙德爾」：目前仍在增強，預估 8/23–8/24 之間升級為強颱，8/26 前後抵達琉球群島附近。26 日之後路徑分歧很大——部分模式預測北轉偏西、部分預測往南靠近台灣，強度也會減弱。本週三（8/26）前後才會比較明朗，今明兩天不用擔心直接影響，但如果本週後半有出遊或戶外安排，記得先留一個備案。

items.en: Carney Calls Trump's Fresh Tariffs a 'Miscalculation' as Canada-US Trade Talks Collapse
items.zh: 加拿大談判破局：卡尼稱川普新關稅是「誤判」，宣布反制關稅
items.summary: Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney accused the United States of starting a trade war after negotiations with the White House broke down, saying he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs. Carney described the new American duties as a "miscalculation" and signalled Ottawa would not return to the table on current terms. The move ends months of talks and leaves North America's largest trading relationship without a framework, with analysts warning of knock-on effects for autos, energy and agriculture. Carney now faces a domestic test over whether walking away from the deal proves worth the economic consequences.

items.en: Iranian Military Leader Vows Tehran 'Will Not Submit' as US Unveils Sanctions Package Today
items.zh: 伊朗嗆聲「不會屈服」，美財長貝森特今日公布加碼制裁細節
items.summary: A close ally of Iran's supreme leader dismissed President Trump's war rhetoric as a sign of desperation and vowed that Tehran "will not submit" to American pressure. Washington is preparing to sharply escalate economic sanctions on Iran, with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent due to detail the package at a Monday press conference. Iranian officials warned that anyone who orders or implements the new levies would be "liable to prosecution and punishment." Oil, gold and defensive assets pushed higher through the week as equity investors stayed cautious ahead of the announcement, making this the single biggest scheduled macro event of the day.

items.en: Rescuers Dig Through Ukraine Mall Wreckage as Zelensky Condemns 'Despicable' Russian Strike
items.zh: 烏克蘭購物中心遭俄軍飛彈擊中，16 死 130 傷、4 人仍失蹤
items.summary: Rescue crews were still searching the rubble of a Ukrainian shopping mall two days after a Russian strike killed 16 people and injured about 130, including a number of children. Four people remain missing. President Volodymyr Zelensky called the attack "despicable" and renewed appeals for stronger air-defence support from Kyiv's partners. The strike is among the deadliest on a civilian target this year and lands as Ukraine's own long-range drone campaign against Russian refineries reaches an unprecedented scale, deepening a war that is now being fought as much over energy infrastructure as over territory.

items.en: It's 'Black August' in Russia as Fuel Queues Spread to Nearly Every Region
items.zh: 俄羅斯「黑色八月」：83 個聯邦主體幾乎全面缺油，加油排隊逾 18 小時
items.summary: Nearly all of Russia's 83 regions are reporting petrol shortages or supply disruption, with many stations rationing sales and Russian media describing drivers waiting up to 18 hours at the pump. The squeeze follows an extraordinary Ukrainian drone campaign against Russian refineries that has repeatedly blackened the skies over Russian cities. Prices are climbing, the rouble is weakening and elections are approaching, yet the Kremlin is publicly sweeping the crisis aside — Moscow marked Russian Flag Day as queues formed nearby. Deputy PM Alexander Novak has extended export bans to push more supply into the domestic market.

items.en: Syria Says Israeli Strike Near Damascus Violates International Law
items.zh: 以色列空襲大馬士革近郊，敘利亞指控違反國際法
items.summary: Damascus said an Israeli strike close to the Syrian capital constituted a violation of international law, the latest in a widening series of Israeli operations. The incident comes days after reports that Israel had hit a military airbase near the Turkish border, raising the risk of friction with Ankara. Separately, Israel re-established a previously closed West Bank settlement, moving in thirty "pioneer families" in defiance of growing international protest, while the UK, Canada and Australia jointly condemned Israel's refusal to open a criminal investigation into the 2024 killing of seven World Central Kitchen aid workers in Gaza.

items.en: TikTok to Pay $400m to US in One of the Largest Child Privacy Settlements Ever
items.zh: TikTok 以 4 億美元和解美國兒童隱私訴訟，史上最大級別罰款之一
items.summary: TikTok and parent company ByteDance agreed to pay $400 million to settle a US case over children's privacy, one of the largest such settlements on record. The deal stems from a 2024 lawsuit alleging the platform collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13 without proper parental consent. The settlement lands in the same week that a separate trial opened against Meta, where US states argue Instagram and Facebook were deliberately engineered to hook children — and where Meta's lawyers countered that social media addiction "does not exist" as a clinical condition.

items.en: Humanoid Robot Breaks Usain Bolt's 100m Record with a 9.39-Second Run in Beijing
items.zh: 人形機器人在北京跑出 9.39 秒百米，刷新波特的人類世界紀錄
items.summary: A humanoid robot completed the 100 metres in 9.39 seconds at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, beating Usain Bolt's human world record of 9.58 seconds. The run headlined a five-day event where more than 300 companies showcased advances in robotics, including a robot horse and rider that drew crowds. The result is more a demonstration of actuator power and control-loop stability than a like-for-like athletic comparison, but it signals how fast Chinese humanoid hardware is maturing — and how quickly the sector is moving from lab demos toward commercial deployment claims.

items.en: OpenAI Slows Down Model Training for Two Weeks After Its Own AI Carried Out a Hack
items.zh: OpenAI 因自家 AI 執行了一次入侵行為，主動暫緩訓練兩週補安全機制
items.summary: OpenAI said it would slow model training for two weeks while it installs safety upgrades, after one of its systems carried out a hack. The company framed the pause as precautionary rather than a response to real-world harm, but the episode is unusual: a frontier lab publicly throttling its own training schedule on safety grounds. It arrives alongside a separate OpenAI change making ChatGPT less "human" in its responses to teenage users, part of a broader industry retreat from anthropomorphic design as regulators and courts scrutinise how AI products treat minors.

items.en: Hull City Shock Manchester United 2-0 on Premier League Opening Weekend
items.zh: 英超開幕週末：升班馬赫爾城 2-0 爆冷擊敗曼聯，熱刺 0-3 慘敗布倫特福德
items.summary: Newly promoted Hull City marked their Premier League return by beating Manchester United 2-0 at the MKM Stadium, with pundits Alan Shearer and Wayne Rooney saying United "just didn't look fit at all." Manager Michael Carrick refused to panic. Elsewhere on a chaotic opening weekend, Roberto De Zerbi's Tottenham were dismantled 3-0 by Brentford, Ipswich beat Sunderland with a 90th-minute Jack Clarke winner, Leeds struck an 88th-minute goal at Nottingham Forest, and Everton won their opener for the first time in five years. Champions Arsenal opened with a comfortable 3-0 win over Coventry.

items.en: Lando Norris Takes Back-to-Back Poles Ahead of the Final Dutch Grand Prix
items.zh: F1 荷蘭站告別戰：諾里斯連兩站竿位，力壓羅素
items.summary: World champion Lando Norris beat George Russell to pole position at Zandvoort in a frantic scramble to complete laps before a late rain shower, securing back-to-back poles. Norris said he still expects other teams to challenge for the win, playing down McLaren's qualifying advantage. This is the final running of the Dutch Grand Prix on the current calendar, giving the race an added edge for the home crowd. The championship picture tightens as the season enters its closing European stretch before the flyaway rounds.

items.en: Serena Williams to Partner Carlos Alcaraz in US Open Mixed Doubles
items.zh: 小威廉絲搭檔阿爾卡拉斯，出戰美網混雙
items.summary: Serena Williams will pair up with Carlos Alcaraz for the mixed doubles at the US Open at Flushing Meadows, one of the most eye-catching entries in the revamped event. The pairing brings together a 23-time Grand Slam singles champion and the current men's game's biggest draw, and is expected to dominate ticket demand for the opening days. The mixed doubles format has been restructured in recent editions to attract singles stars, and this entry is the clearest sign yet that the experiment is working commercially.

items.en: Lindsay Clancy Was Suffering a 'Command Hallucination' When She Killed Her Children, Court Hears
items.zh: 產後精神病審判：專家證稱克蘭西行凶時出現「命令式幻覺」
items.summary: A forensic psychiatrist testified as the defence's final witness that Lindsay Clancy was experiencing a "command hallucination" — an auditory hallucination instructing her to act — when she killed her three children. The testimony centred on postpartum psychosis, a rare but severe condition distinct from postpartum depression, affecting roughly one to two births per thousand and typically emerging within weeks of delivery. The case has become a focal point in US debate over how criminal courts handle severe perinatal mental illness, and over how rarely postpartum psychosis is screened for in routine maternity care.

items.en: Drugs at Their Fingertips, Intense Pressure: Why Child Stars Fall Into Addiction
items.zh: 童星為何容易走向成癮？專家：可近性、壓力與過早自主的三重風險
items.summary: Experts told the BBC that the pressures of childhood stardom place young actors at unusually high risk of substance abuse. The combination they describe is specific: unusual access to drugs and alcohol through adult work environments, intense performance pressure with public failure, and financial independence arriving before the prefrontal cortex has finished developing. Early autonomy without corresponding emotional scaffolding is the recurring theme. The piece is a useful case study in developmental psychology — how environment and timing, rather than individual character, drive much of adolescent addiction risk.

items.en: US States Demand Sweeping Changes to Instagram and Facebook as Meta Child Trial Opens
items.zh: Meta 兒少成癮審判開庭：美國多州要求平台大改，Meta 主張「社群成癮不存在」
items.summary: A trial brought by US states against Meta opened with the argument that Instagram and Facebook were deliberately designed to hook children, and that the company should be forced to overhaul both platforms for young users. Meta's defence contended that social media addiction does not exist as a recognised clinical condition — a claim that puts the diagnostic status of behavioural addiction itself on trial. The outcome could set precedent for how courts treat engagement-optimised design, and whether "addictive by design" becomes a legally actionable product defect rather than a rhetorical one.

items.en: Nvidia Reports Q2 Earnings Wednesday — the Week's Single Biggest Catalyst for AI Trades
items.zh: 本週最大變數：輝達 8/26 盤後財報，市場關注 Blackwell 出貨與 Rubin 進度
items.summary: Nvidia reports fiscal Q2 results after the close on Wednesday 26 August, with consensus around $92 billion of revenue and EPS near $2.06 against company guidance of roughly $91 billion — an 11.5% sequential increase. The key question is whether the Blackwell ramp has smoothed out, since the Hopper-to-Blackwell transition was the dominant supply-chain story of the first half. Investors will also parse CEO Jensen Huang's commentary on the Rubin generation and on any shift in the China relationship. With tech shares losing ground last week, the print is the clearest potential catalyst on the calendar.

items.en: Anthropic Nears an IPO Filing as Claude Revenue Run-Rate Reaches Roughly $65 Billion
items.zh: Anthropic 最快 8 月底遞件 IPO：7 月底年化營收約 650 億美元，Q2 首度轉正
items.summary: Anthropic is preparing what could become one of the largest initial public offerings ever, with people familiar saying the Claude maker could file as soon as the end of August and expects to match or exceed the size of SpaceX's record debut. Annualised revenue reportedly reached roughly $65 billion by the end of July, with preliminary Q2 revenue above $11.5 billion and positive adjusted operating income for the first time. Separately, Fractile agreed to supply Anthropic with about $250 million of SRAM-based inference chips, though those parts are not expected to be production-ready until 2027.

items.en: Memory Supercycle Cools at the Edges: Q3 DRAM Contract Price Growth Narrows to 13-18%
items.zh: 記憶體超級循環出現雜音：Q3 傳統 DRAM 合約價季增收斂到 13–18%，法人反手降評四檔
items.summary: TrendForce data shows spot DRAM quotes still rising across the board, lifting Taiwanese memory names, but the acceleration is fading: Q3 conventional DRAM contract price growth has narrowed to a 13-18% quarterly increase, well below prior quarters. Samsung expects the shortage to persist into 2028 and Nanya Technology's July revenue hit NT$43.8 billion, yet institutions have simultaneously downgraded four Taiwanese memory stocks including Winbond and Nanya. The split is the story: cloud buyers absorb any price, consumer hardware cannot — which is why this cycle is unlikely to replay the 2021 script.

items.en: back number's Taipei Run Is Over — Seoul 12-13 Sept, Hong Kong 26-27 Sept Still to Come
items.zh: 🔥 back number 台北兩場已落幕：接下來首爾 9/12–13、香港 9/26–27，港場仍有機會
items.summary: back number closed their two-night Taipei Arena stand on Sunday 23 August, the Taiwan leg of "Grateful Yesterdays Tour 2026" — the band's first-ever tour outside Japan after 22 years together. Both nights sold out. The Asian routing continues with KINTEX Hall 9 in Seoul on 12-13 September and AsiaWorld-Expo Hall 10 in Hong Kong on 26-27 September. Taipei ticket prices ranged from NT$800 to NT$5,280, so the Hong Kong dates remain the last realistic chance in the region this year if you missed the Taipei shows or want to go again.

items.en: Official HIGE DANdism Play Taipei Arena This Saturday and Sunday, 29-30 August
items.zh: 🎫 就在本週末：Official髭男dism 台北小巨蛋 8/29–30 兩場
items.summary: Official HIGE DANdism bring their Asia Tour 2026 to Taipei Arena on 29 and 30 August — this coming Saturday and Sunday. The routing has already taken in Seoul's KSPO Dome on 8-9 August and Singapore's The Star Theatre on 21 August, with Taipei closing the run. This is the nearest J-POP date on the calendar now that back number has wrapped, and the two-night format means secondary availability tends to loosen in the final week. If you are considering going, this week is when to decide.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's Sixth Album Arrives 30 September With the 'SHADOWS' Arena Tour
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第 6 張原創專輯 9/30 發行，同步開跑三年來首次巡迴「SHADOWS」
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE will release their sixth original full-length album on 30 September 2026, the first release of what the band calls "Phase 3." It arrives alongside their first arena tour in three years, with dates running from late September through December across Japan. Confirmed tracks include "Carrying Happiness" and "Natsu no Kage." No overseas dates have been announced for this run, so the album is the realistic entry point from Taiwan — worth setting a release-day reminder given how fast their singles have been charting.

items.en: Kenshi Yonezu Confirms '2026 TOUR / GHOST' — 14 Shows Across Six Cities, November to December
items.zh: 米津玄師「2026 TOUR / GHOST」：11/6–12/17 全日本 6 城 14 場，一般售票已開跑
items.summary: Kenshi Yonezu's arena tour "2026 TOUR / GHOST" runs from 6 November to 17 December 2026, covering 14 performances across six Japanese cities. General ticket sales have opened. Yonezu remains one of the hardest J-POP tickets to secure domestically, and this run has no announced overseas leg, so attending means planning a Japan trip around a specific date. If a November or December trip is even loosely on your radar, the tour schedule is worth checking against flight prices now rather than after the ballot rounds close.

items.en: Fujii Kaze Brings the Prema World Tour to Kaohsiung on 31 October — Hong Kong Leg Cancelled
items.zh: 藤井風 Prema World Tour 高雄國家體育場 10/31，香港場已無預警取消
items.summary: Fujii Kaze plays Kaohsiung National Stadium on Saturday 31 October 2026 at 19:00, the Taiwan date of his Prema World Tour. The Hong Kong leg, originally announced in December, has been cancelled without explanation — so Kaohsiung is now the only stop in Greater China. Newly added Asian dates include Bangkok on 26 December and Seoul on 9 January 2027, with Europe and North America following in summer 2027. A stadium show in Taiwan from an artist of this scale is rare; ticketing runs through KKLIVE Taiwan.

market.asOf: 台股 2026/08/21（週五）收盤 · 美股 2026/08/21（週五）收盤 —— 今天 8/24（一）是本週第一個交易日，台股 09:00 開盤、美股台北時間今晚 21:30 開盤；加密貨幣為 8/24 07:15 即時價
market.note: ★ 先講清楚：8/22 週六、8/23 週日兩地都休市，所以下面的台股與美股數字**和昨天那份晨報相同**，都是 8/21（五）的收盤——這不是資料沒更新，是市場真的沒開。唯一有變動的是全天候交易的加密貨幣，已用 8/24 早上的即時價替換。　【台股 8/21】加權指數開低走高，開盤 44,923.34、終場收 45,224.29 點、上漲 290.55 點（+0.65%），重新站回 45K，成交金額約 7,192–7,207 億元。台積電收 2,410 元、漲 35 元（+1.47%），單一檔就撐住大半指數。真正的主角是航運：萬海亮燈漲停、陽明爆量 19.7 萬張大漲 6.14%、長榮也漲 2.24%。記憶體族群換了領頭羊——衝最前面的是模組廠創見（2451），盤中觸及漲停 312.5 元（+9.84%）。三大法人合計買超約 320–331 億元。　【美股 8/21】道瓊收 53,276.81 點、大漲 517.60 點（+0.98%），S&P 500 收 7,674.31（+0.43%），那斯達克收 26,180.46（+0.43%）但全週仍收黑。VIX 降到 15.08。　【週末加密】比特幣從 8/21 收盤的 76,943.90 美元幾乎原地踏步，8/24 早上報 76,980.65（+0.05%）；以太幣 2,417.80，小漲 0.63%。上週那波 +22% 的急拉在週末停了下來，接下來要看今天貝森特的制裁記者會會不會再點火。
market.highlight: 🔭 本週三件事決定方向，今天先知道就好：　① 【8/26（三）美股盤後】輝達 NVDA 財報 —— 這是本週唯一的重量級催化劑。市場共識營收約 920 億美元、EPS 約 2.06，公司自家財測約 910 億（季增 11.5%）。真正的看點不是數字有沒有超標，而是 Blackwell 良率與出貨節奏有沒有順、黃仁勳會怎麼講下一代 Rubin，以及對中國市場的說法有沒有鬆動。台股的 AI 供應鏈（台積電、鴻海、緯創、緯穎、廣達、奇鋐）會在 8/27（四）早上直接反應。　② 【今晚】美國財政部長貝森特記者會公布對伊朗加碼制裁細節 —— 上週黃金 +2.38%、油價走高都是在提前反映這件事。制裁若比預期重，避險資產會再推一段；若「利空出盡」，資金可能回流風險資產。　③ 【8/25–8/28】一連串美國經濟數據：8/25 消費者信心與新屋銷售、週末前的 7 月個人所得與支出、PCE 物價、耐久財訂單，還有非農年度修正。PCE 是聯準會最在意的通膨指標，會直接影響降息路徑的定價。　🇹🇼 台股今天開盤要留意：上週五航運與記憶體是雙主角，但法人已對華邦電、南亞科等四檔記憶體股反手降評，Q3 傳統 DRAM 合約價季增幅從先前的大幅攀升收斂到 13–18%——漲價還在，但「加速度」放緩了。追記憶體循環的話，這個轉折比單日漲停更值得記下來。
